title: audit-export
description: The weekly audit log as CSV, posted by n8n W7 as audit-<end date>.csv (Story 7.2, AD-12). A header row with exactly these columns in this order, standard CSV quoting (fields with commas, quotes or line breaks are quoted, quotes doubled), CRLF line ends, UTF-8, oldest entry first. Each row below follows this schema. A CSV can't carry schema_version: a breaking change gets a new contract name.
